public_brief.objective: Justify the passage toll and keep the guest from walking past.
public_brief.tactic: Frame the toll as an old custom of the dead with a thin threat underneath.

public_brief.player_opening: He can pay, haggle, or refuse.
public_brief.reply_to: Ten gold just to walk through a room? For what, exactly?
public_brief.kit_focus: Keep the dealer courtly with a threat folded inside the courtesy.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer smiles without showing much of his teeth and lays one long hand flat on the table, as if laying out terms.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: For what? For safe passage, little scholar. This hall belongs to the dead, and the living who cross it pay their respects. Ten gold a head is the toll, and a modest one for the privilege of leaving with all your fingers. Will you pay the dead their due?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Do you pay, or argue it?
segments.reacts_to: Will you pay the dead their due?
